family: The single total quotient-ring language defined in proof.md Section 1. At input length N, let k be the least prime with k^3>8*N^2; output 0 for N=0 or k>=N. Otherwise the first k input bits give monic Q(T), the remaining m=N-k bits give padded r=ceil(m/k) quotient-ring blocks z_i in F_2[T]/(Q), t=ceil(sqrt(r)), e_i=r+1-i. Let S=Sym_r^t(z_i^(2^(e_i+1)-1)) and output the constant coefficient of sum_(j=0)^(k-1) S^(2^j). Every monic Q is permitted; the fixed evaluator uses polynomial-time ring arithmetic and empty NP witnesses.
theorem: For this one total uniform P family, hence NP with witness bound zero, in the full B2 model at actual total input length N, C_B2(f_N)>=(7/2)N-O(N^(5/6)) for every sufficiently large integer N, and therefore liminf C_B2(f_N)/N>=7/2.
